name: candidate
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND true RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: candidate-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND true RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: reverse-candidate
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE true AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: reverse-candidate-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE true AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: candidate-throw
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: candidate-throw-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: reverse-throw
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE substring('x','bad')='x' AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: reverse-throw-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE substring('x','bad')='x' AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: candidate-false
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND false RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: candidate-false-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND false RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: candidate-or-residual
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE (n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_name='target') AND n.id>0 RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: candidate-or-residual-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE (n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_name='target') AND n.id>0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: direct-conjunction
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND n.callee_name='target' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: direct-conjunction-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND n.callee_name='target' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: direct-conjunction-reversed
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.callee_name='target' AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: direct-conjunction-reversed-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.callee_name='target' AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: regex-candidate
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name =~ '.*\\Qother\\E.*' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: regex-candidate-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name =~ '.*\\Qother\\E.*' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: generic-wrapper
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: generic-wrapper-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: generic-empty
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name,'')) CONTAINS '' RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: generic-empty-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name,'')) CONTAINS '' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: generic-id
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: generic-id-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: param-candidate
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS $term AND n.id>$id RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: param-null-candidate
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS $term AND true RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: param-nonstring-candidate
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS $term AND true RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: route-candidate
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.graphId='b' AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' AND true RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: route-param
query: MATCH (n) WHERE graphId(n)=$graph AND n.caller_name CONTAINS $term AND true RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: route-conflict
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.graphId='a' AND n.graphId='b' AND substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: inline
query: MATCH (n {caller_name:$term}) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: inline-before-where
query: MATCH (n {caller_name:substring('x','bad')}) WHERE false RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: inline-mismatch-before-throw
query: MATCH (n {caller_name:'absent',callee_name:substring('x','bad')}) WHERE true RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: zero-before-inline
query: MATCH (n {caller_name:substring('x','bad')}) WHERE true RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x LIMIT 0

name: all-label-constraint
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode:FieldNode) WHERE true RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: whole-owned
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN [n,n.id] AS x LIMIT 3

name: nested-owned
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN {node:n,ids:[n.id]} AS x LIMIT 3

name: alias-overwrite
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x,n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: distinct-alias
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x,n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: metadata-alias
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS `$metadata` LIMIT 1

name: distinct-qualified-drain
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN DISTINCT CASE WHEN n.id=90 THEN substring('x','bad') ELSE 1 END AS x LIMIT 1

name: projection-error
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x

name: raw-unbounded
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.id AS x

name: wrapped-unbounded
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.id AS x

name: generic-unbounded
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN n.id AS x

name: inline-unbounded
query: MATCH (n {caller_name:'other'}) WHERE n.id>=0 RETURN n.id AS x

name: route-unbounded
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.graphId='b' AND n.id>=0 RETURN n.id AS x

name: constraints-first-unbounded
query: MATCH (n {caller_name:substring('x','bad')}) WHERE false RETURN n.id AS x
